panels.title: Pool state
panels.description: node_zfs_zpool_state for pool nas; any state other than online means lost redundancy or a stopped pool.

panels.title: Permanent data errors
panels.description: zfs_pool_data_errors: files the mirror could not repair (zpool status -v lists them).

panels.title: Since last scrub
panels.description: Time since zfs_pool_scrub_end_timestamp_seconds; the scrub timer runs on the 1st of each month.

panels.title: Last scrub errors
panels.description: zfs_pool_scrub_errors: unrepairable errors found by the last scrub.

panels.title: Drives
panels.description: One row per pool drive, keyed by serial: ZFS vdev state and error counters (zfs_disk_*), SMART health, grown defect list and temperature (smartctl_exporter), last SCSI self-test result and its age on the drive's power-on clock (smart_selftest_*).

targets.expr: max by (serial) (zfs_disk_errors{job="minerva-nas-node", type="read"} * on (disk) group_left (serial) nas_disk_info{job="minerva-nas-node"})
max by (serial) (zfs_disk_errors{job="minerva-nas-node", type="write"} * on (disk) group_left (serial) nas_disk_info{job="minerva-nas-node"})
max by (serial) (zfs_disk_errors{job="minerva-nas-node", type="checksum"} * on (disk) group_left (serial) nas_disk_info{job="minerva-nas-node"})
max by (serial) (smartctl_device_temperature{job="minerva-nas-smartctl", temperature_type="current"} * on (device) group_left (serial) nas_disk_info{job="minerva-nas-node"})

panels.title: Drive temperature
panels.description: smartctl_device_temperature (current) per drive serial; the drives trip at 60 °C.

targets.expr: max by (serial) (smartctl_device_temperature{job="minerva-nas-smartctl", temperature_type="current"} * on (device) group_left (serial) nas_disk_info{job="minerva-nas-node"})

panels.title: Grown defect list
panels.description: smartctl_scsi_grown_defect_list per drive serial: sectors the drive has remapped since manufacture.

panels.title: Pull sources
panels.description: backup_pull_configured (1 when the source has paths) and the time since backup_pull_last_success_timestamp_seconds.

panels.title: Newest snapshot
panels.description: Time since zfs_snapshot_newest_timestamp_seconds per dataset; sanoid snapshots nas/backup hourly.

panels.title: Exporters up
panels.description: up for the minerva-nas-node and minerva-nas-smartctl scrape jobs.

panels.title: Failed units
panels.description: Count of node_systemd_unit_state{state="failed"} == 1 on the NAS.

panels.title: Since metrics update
panels.description: Time since nas_metrics_last_success_timestamp_seconds; the nas-metrics timer runs every 5 minutes.

panels.title: ARC size
panels.description: node_zfs_arc_size: ZFS read cache in the VM's RAM.

panels.title: Pool throughput
panels.description: Sum over datasets of rate(node_zfs_zpool_dataset_nread/nwritten) in pool nas.
